1.explanation: In BreadcrumbItem.js, the code only recognizes an OverflowMenu child when its displayName is exactly "OverflowMenu" or "FeatureToggle(OverflowMenu)". By wrapping the OverflowMenu in a custom HOC (simulating the new createComponentToggle behavior), its displayName becomes "ComponentToggle". This fails the instanceof check, so BreadcrumbItem renders the fallback code path (a plain <li> with the menu inside) instead of the special overflow branch that adds the shark-fin icon and applies the correct menuOffset. The snippet above reproduces this mismatch and shows the missing shark fin and incorrect popover position.
1.bug_scenario: When an OverflowMenu component is wrapped by a higher-order component (for example via the new createComponentToggle API or a FeatureToggle), its children.type.displayName no longer matches the hard-coded strings "OverflowMenu" or "FeatureToggle(OverflowMenu)". As a result, BreadcrumbItem skips its special overflow branch (which renders the shark-fin icon and applies the proper menuOffset) and falls back to rendering a plain list item with the OverflowMenu inside. The overflow menu still works, but there is no little triangle (shark fin) pointing at it and the popover anchor is in the wrong place.
